stemMd: Only manuscripts received by Friday will be read this month. Every manuscript read this month will receive written feedback. Nara received written feedback on her manuscript. Which follows?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Nara's manuscript was received by Friday.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Nara's manuscript was read this month.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Every manuscript received by Friday will be read this month.

options.label: D
options.textMd: No manuscript received after Friday can ever receive feedback.

options.label: E
options.textMd: If Nara's manuscript was read this month, it was received by Friday.

explanationMd: Keep the two implications in their stated direction: reading this month requires Friday receipt and produces feedback. Observing feedback does not establish reading this month. The conditional claim simply preserves the first rule.

distractorRationale.a: Feedback could have arisen through another route.
distractorRationale.b: Written feedback is not stated to require reading this month.
distractorRationale.c: Friday receipt is necessary, not sufficient.
distractorRationale.d: The premises restrict this month, not all future reading.
